* Name 5 topic: <uuid>
* Name 1 — 4-day stall, 1,564 leads, 0 sent
* Name 2 — 2-week stall, 1,442 leads, 0 sent
* Name 3 Name 6 — confirmed today

## Why new

No open canonical matches this exact symptom. ENG-11571 (Todo) is the false "no email accounts connected" warning variant; ENG-9720 tracks follow-ups (step 2) stalling after bulk import; ENG-4577 (Canceled) and ENG-9492 (Done) are older/closed. None cover "Active + connected + windows passing + literally zero dispatch" at this volume/duration. Filed as a distinct urgent to track the dispatch-pipeline failure.

relatedSnapshot.title: Customer report: all 15 pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error, Reconnect returns "Mailbox not found", campaigns cannot send
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Source

Intercom conversation: <url:app.intercom.com>

## Bounded conversation context

Customer reports (2026-09-22) that every pre-warmed inbox in the workspace shows an Error status, that reconnect attempts stay at "Reconnect in Progress" for over 48 hours, and that toggling an inbox to enabled briefly shows Active before it returns to Error. On 2026-09-23 she adds that her campaign stopped running and that she cannot start any new campaigns. Frontline agent reactivated the inboxes on 2026-09-22 and confirmed they still failed, then escalated to the tech team.

* Product area named on the conversation: Email accounts & domains
* Workspace: cold email agent email-accounts page, 15 pre-warmed inboxes across 5 domains (5 completed pre-warmed orders, all provisioned 2026-03-30)

## Testable claim

Every pre-warmed inbox in the workspace is in Error and cannot be reconnected: the Reconnect path sends a mailbox id ColdMailReseller does not resolve, so the provider answers "Mailbox not found" and the inbox never returns to Active, which leaves the workspace with no sending accounts and blocks campaign sending.

## Current evidence

* 15/15 mail_inbox rows status=error, connected=false; 14 carry "Disconnected via Company One account_error webhook", 1 carries the "Mailbox not found" OAuth exception.
* 53 Company One account_error webhook events between 2026-09-19T15:07Z and 2026-09-23T05:57Z for these accounts.
* 15 failed cea_oauth_sessions, each with "Mailbox OAuth connection threw an exception: Mailbox not found. Context: mailboxId=<stored provider_id>, email=<address>", between 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-22.
* Last email_sent webhook for the workspace: 2026-09-18T19:37Z. One campaign is still "active" with no sends; three campaigns sit in draft.
* Provider side: the corresponding Company One accounts exist in the workspace sub-workspace and report warmup activity, so the durable failure is the Acquisity reconnect path, not a missing provider account.

## Suspected code path

* apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/process-account-error-reconnect.ts (processAccountErrorReconnect) marks the inbox Error and invokes processConnectOAuth with mailboxId = stored mail_inbox.provider_id.
* apps/web/trpc/routers/outreach/email-accounts.ts (triggerOAuthReconnect) sends mailboxId: undefined for a customer-initiated Reconnect.
* apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/process-connect-oauth.ts forwards that id to ColdMailReseller POST /mailboxes/oauth.

relatedSnapshot.title: Active campaign shows "No email accounts connected" despite 6 connected accounts and active sending
relatedSnapshot.description:
Intercom source: <url:app.intercom.com>

Conversation context: Customer Name 12 reports his cold email campaign "Family owned Manufacture Companies" shows the banner "No email accounts connected. Add one to start sending." even though 6 email accounts are connected and selected (all green). He asked whether the campaign is performing correctly and requested a human because he believes it is a bug. Screenshots show the banner on the Analytics tab and 6 selected accounts on the Options tab.

Testable claim: An active cold email campaign shows the banner "No email accounts connected. Add one to start sending." even though 6 email accounts are connected, active, and selected, and the campaign is actively sending emails.

Evidence:

* Campaign <uuid> (org <uuid>, "Company Three", slug <workspace-slug>) is status active, display_status active, pause_reason null.
* settings.emailAccounts contains 6 addresses; metadata.providerData.email_list contains the same 6; mail_inbox has 6 rows all status active / connected true / connection_error null.
* outreach_webhook_event shows email_sent events as recent as 2026-09-03T18:59Z (900 in the last 7 days), so the campaign is actively sending.
* The banner is driven by Company One's /campaigns/{id}/sending-status returning summary.status "no_accounts_available", rendered in apps/web/components/campaigns/detail/header/index.tsx (SendingStatusPill + FRIENDLY_STATUS_COPY.no_accounts_available), fetched via apps/web/lib/outreach/Company One/client.ts getCampaignSendingStatus.

This matches known bug ENG-10717 (Backlog): the header trusts Company One's "no_accounts_available" status without reconciling against settings.emailAccounts / mail_inbox / provider email_list.

relatedSnapshot.title: Campaign header says no accounts connected despite selected external Company One accounts
relatedSnapshot.description:
BUG: Yes
EVIDENCE:
Intercom conversation 215474815491860 shows Company Four campaign <uuid> displaying the header warning "No email accounts connected. Add one to start sending" while the Options tab shows 18 selected email accounts. Prod DB confirms outreach_campaign.settings.emailAccounts contains 18 addresses, campaign status/display_status are active, provider is active with no connection_error, and mail_inbox has 0 rows because these are external/user-owned Company One inboxes. Axiom logs at 2026-06-23T18:22:26-18:22:27Z show Updating campaign settings, Updating campaign in provider, Database update completed, and Triggered daily email limit recalculation for the same campaign, but the customer still saw the header warning. Customer also hit a generic Application Error after trying support's pause/remove/re-add/resume workaround; Axiom at 2026-06-23T18:24:24Z logs Failed to initiate campaign resume because the campaign was already active, which appears covered separately by ENG-9785. Prior completed tickets ENG-7810/ENG-8081/ENG-8101 had the same symptom, suggesting regression or incomplete fix.
POTENTIAL FIX:
Audit campaign detail header status derivation for external Company One campaigns. If provider sending status returns no_accounts_available while the campaign has selected settings.emailAccounts and provider update succeeded, reconcile with provider campaign email_list and/or surface a sync-specific warning instead of saying no accounts are connected. Also avoid sending users into resume when campaign is already active.
WHATS NEEDED TO RESOLVE:
Reproduce with org <uuid> / campaign <uuid>, inspect Company One campaign <uuid> email_list and status response, then fix header/resync behavior for external inbox campaigns.

relatedSnapshot.title: Investigate: cold email campaign "Built for Success-Saas" (Name 15) shows no emails sent for two days after manual toggle, despite Active status and connected inboxes
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Source

Intercom conversation: <url:app.intercom.com>
Intercom conversation id: 21547599575186

## Claim (testable)

A cold email customer reports that the campaign "Built for Success-Saas" (workspace <workspace-slug>) stopped sending emails for two days after the campaign was toggled from automatic back on, even though the campaign shows Active, 9 inboxes are connected, and enough leads are uploaded; the same page also reports 4,928 leads skipped during upload. Hypothesis to verifying stage: the campaign's own daily send limits (daily_limit / daily_max_leads) were zeroed by the even-split planner during the 2026-09-17 pause/resume while a second campaign existed in the workspace, and no send window has elapsed since, so the campaign reports Active but cannot send.

## Bounded conversation context

* 2026-09-18 (customer, first message): "Help! None of no emails went out in my campaign and I don't know why." Campaign link: Built for Success-Saas.
* Customer follow-up: "My campaign was turned off because I had it set to automatic, and now that I turned it back on, no emails have been sent from the campaign for the past two days"; campaign shows the email addresses, is active, and has enough leads uploaded.
* Customer: "It says 4,928 leads were skipped during upload, 5 on the do not contact list. I need help ... It needs to be running by Monday."
* Fin AI answered with generic checks (campaign status, sending schedule, inboxes) and escalated to a human; a teammate acknowledged.

## Requested follow-up

Confirm the cause, record the blast radius from current production data, identify the first divergent hop if the campaign limits are not the cause, and provide the exact unblock (which field a human must correct and its value). The customer needs the campaign sending before Monday.
